name: IRG
source: Supplied 2026-10-03 logo screenshot. Dominant solid RGB colors sampled from its pixels; geometry matches the existing approved IRG People Mark.

logo.geometry: Three 8-unit figures, 2-unit horizontal gaps. Outer heads begin at y=2; middle head begins at y=0. Rounded bodies share the y=28 baseline.
logo.wordmark: Existing BDO Grotesk Variable at weight 600, outlined as vector paths with the existing -0.04em spacing.
logo.darkSurfaceUsage: Keep the original red, blue and ink fills on a transparent background. Dark-surface variants use a white wordmark and a fine 0.65-unit paper-colored outline behind the ink figure to preserve its original filled geometry without a backing tile.
logo.backgroundUsage: Logo SVGs, favicon and Apple touch icon have transparent backgrounds. The social preview retains its full paper-colored design canvas, with no separate logo backing block.

usage.red: Exact logo red is the text fill. Small red labels use an ink support surface; red on white/paper is limited to large text. The existing redAction button-background stop remains unchanged.
usage.blue: Exact logo blue is the text fill. Blue text retains a plain fill without outlines, backing surfaces or added padding. The Hospitality jump control uses exact blue background with white text.
usage.inverseRed: Exact logo red on ink surfaces; no pale alternate red.
usage.inverseBlue: Exact logo blue on dark surfaces, without outlines, light backing or added padding, at the user’s direction.
usage.gradient: Existing red-to-blue CTA styling retained with darker stops; minimum measured white contrast across 1001 sampled gradient positions is documented in release checks.
usage.ink: Exact logo ink replaces neutral black/gray reading text on pale surfaces. Original white reading text on dark surfaces is preserved.

buttonGradient.measurementMethod: Piecewise linear sRGB interpolation at t=i/1000 for i=0..1000, including all three stops; WCAG relative luminance and (Llighter+0.05)/(Ldarker+0.05).

contrast.usage: Actual support surface for small red labels.
Raw palette comparison only; no paper backing is applied to inverse inline links.

primary.selfHosting: Existing Framer font binary preserved byte-for-byte. Redistribution allowed by embedded OFL 1.1 license and official project license; original copyright notice and full license included.

contrastLimitations: Exact red on white/paper fails ordinary-size text AA but passes large text AA; small red labels use ink. Exact blue directly on ink fails ordinary and large text AA. At the user’s direction, blue text has no outline or backing surface, including dark-surface headings and inverse inline links. Their raw blue/ink pairing does not meet AA. The ledger documents raw color pairs, not a claim that all pairs, photographic contexts or the entire website pass AA.
